server.description: Core server identification and network metadata

name.description: Fully qualified hostname of the IRC server (must be resolvable)

description.description: Human-readable server description shown in /links and /version

network.description: Network name visible in server links and client info

network_id.description: Unique lowercase ID for the network (used in STS and other internal references)

limits.description: Maximum lengths and counts enforced network-wide

max_nick_length.description: Maximum allowed length of a nickname

max_channel_length.description: Maximum length of a channel name

max_message_length.description: Maximum total length of a message line (including prefix and command)

max_bans.description: Maximum number of ban entries per channel

max_modes.description: Maximum number of modes per channel

operators.description: List of network operators (opers) with administrative privileges

password_hash.description: Argon2id hash (or similar) of operator’s password; never store plaintext

mask.description: User/hostmask pattern that this oper may use to authenticate

flags.description: List of permission flags for this oper

listeners.description: List of TCP listener endpoints (ports + bind addresses) for clients

tls.description: Whether to use TLS on this listener

tls_cert.description: Path to TLS certificate file (PEM format); required if tls=true

tls_key.description: Path to TLS private key file; required if tls=true

tls.description: Global TLS defaults (for optional client-side TLS support)

enabled.description: Enable TLS globally (used for STS and legacy fallback)

advanced.description: Optional advanced features and protocol extensions

enable_webirc.description: Enable WebIRC gateway support (for web clients connecting via proxy)

enable_ban_reasons.description: Include ban reason in MODE +b output

enable_sts.description: Enable STS (TLS Policy) support for auto-upgrading connections

sts_duration.description: STS duration in seconds (30 days typical)

sts_preload.description: Include 'preload' flag in STS header (for HSTS preload list)
